plain: A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb says there is a National Underwater Reconnaissance Office, which he calls the NURO, a secret US agency for spying under the sea. According to him it was set up in 1969 and has still not been officially acknowledged. He tells it on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, because if true it would mean a whole government agency has stayed hidden for over fifty years.
